# cato_ip_address_range_container (Data Source)

The `cato_ip_address_range_container` data source fetches information about account IPv4 range containers with optional filters. Returns a list of containers matching the filter criteria. Member values are not included; use the container's ID with the provider's import/download tooling to inspect members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
## Providers ###
provider "cato" {
  baseurl    = "https://api.catonetworks.com/api/v1/graphql2"
  token      = var.cato_token
  account_id = var.account_id
}

### Data Source Usage ###

# Example: Read all IP address range containers
data "cato_ip_address_range_container" "all" {}

# Example: Read IP address range containers by name
data "cato_ip_address_range_container" "by_name" {
  name_filter = ["Corp-Subnets", "Partner-Subnets"]
}

# Example: Read IP address range containers by ID
data "cato_ip_address_range_container" "by_id" {
  id_filter = ["12345", "67890"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id_filter` (List of String) List of container IDs to filter by
- `name_filter` (List of String) List of container names to filter by

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) List of IP address range containers matching the filter criteria (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Container description
- `id` (String) Container ID
- `mode` (String) INLINE or URL, derived from whether the container has synchronization settings
- `name` (String) Container name
- `size` (Number) Number of members reported by the API
